notes.title: Update to Version 1.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone the big update of today includes the following:

[list]
[*]Reworked tutorial
[*]Reworked base hub
[*]Reworked the story writing
[*]Added a story for the Halloween event. Event is now playable after finishing the main game
[*]Five new enemies and three reworked enemies
[*]One reworked pet
[*]Revamp of most of the achievements
[*]Controlls can now be adjusted again
[*]Leaderboards are now viewable in the hub
[*]New sounds and music
[*]The game now supports the german language
[*]Many bug fixes
[/list]

Unfortunately due to all these changes (and many intern ones) the old save games are not supported anymore.

notes.title: Halloween Event Part 2 Version 1.3
notes.content:
The Update contains some completely new features:

[list]
[*]your are now able to unlock skins and equip them, to individualise your experience
[*]endless levels with leaderboards for all the 3 worlds + one for the Halloween event
[*]an event shop with a new Halloween inspired currency
[*]new extra upgrades to improve yourself even further
[/list]

The following things were also added / redone:

[list]
[*]rework of the previous Halloween boss
[*]new Halloween levels including a new boss fight
[*]a new pet to collect
[*]exclusive Halloween skins
[*]rework of the lighting of the levels
[*]bug fixes
[/list]

Also the game will go on sale on Halloween.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41792622/286e9560ec09df8c6eb7e208f80667b466a22446.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Event Version 1.1
notes.content:
Starting today there will be new, Halloween-themed stages for everyone who completed half the normal game. But be warned - the stages should be tried after getting some upgrades. 

In total the Update containing the Halloween event adds the following:
[list]
[*]4 new stages including a new boss
[*]3 new achievments
[*]a new enemy type
[*]a new pet
[*]difficulty adjustments
[*]bug fixes 
[/list]

Already wishing everyone a Happy Halloween :).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41792622/eac9f827e480b88d6826eff13d7e02953d89f18e.png[/img]

notes.title: Pre release Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Pillars of Sorrow will be fully released in the next couple of days. This update (0.95) already contains the major contents. The release Update will only contain some better story visualisation, as well as a better Steam discription / screenshots and updated achievements. Unfortunately the old safe games will probably not work anymore.

0.95 contains:

[list]
[*]the final boss fight
[*]two new stages
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41792622/9100520fa12cda006808957b2b596c7c0cb9df0f.png[/img]

tags.feature: -two new stages

notes.title: Update to Version 0.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

today we have a bigger update containing:

[list]
[*]full controller support for the game
[*]new key mapping functions
[*]New Secret boss (has something to do with the scrolls)
[*]A new Achievement
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

Also the game price will be reduced by a good amount. The next update will probably come with the full release and will finally introduce the final boss and the remaining story chapters.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.85
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

here a few additions to the game in today´s smaller update.

The update contains:
[list]
[*]2 new stages in world 3 (featuring new enemies and a new pet)
[*]Enhancements of some boss fights
[*]A new achievement
[*]Balance adjustments

[/list]

There are two more planned updates, the main focus will be to implement the final boss, the story (which is already in the making), as well as the actual implementation of the scrolls.

notes.title: Update to Version 0.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

today is the release of the first big update, bringing Pillars of Sorrow to version 0.8.

The update contains:
[list]
[*]4 new stages in world 3 (featuring new enemies, a new boss and a new pet)
[*]New light effects to enhance the overall game experience
[*]Dissolve effects for all enemies upon death
[*]Rework of the spawn system making it fairer for the player
[*]Some enemy reworks
[*]New achievements
[*]Balance adjustments
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]

Before the next bigger update, there will probably be a smaller one bringing some smaller adjustments. Until then, have a great day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41792622/609201c88d55b2b27491128948ee81c417f5f181.png[/img]
